card.name: Words linking a cause to its effect
card.fires_on: Verbs or small linking words that sit right before the agent or cause in a causal statement, such as 'caused' before 'by', 'prevented' before 'by', or 'to' before 'induce'. It appears in drug interaction and effect sentences.

modes.label: Passive effect verbs
modes.description: A verb like caused, prevented or reversed that leads into 'by' plus the agent.
modes.example: attenuates potassium loss<< caused>> by thiazide-type diuretics

modes.label: Linking word before an effect verb
modes.description: A small word such as to or will that comes just before the verb describing what happens.
modes.example: strips of heart muscle<< will>> contract when removed from the body

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a causal or ability statement, such as 'can' or 'will', though the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese and not very informative.
card.plain: It lights up on words in the middle of a sentence about what causes, prevents or reverses an effect.
